The smokeable profit spread -- whether Marlboro net pricing (retail price +7% YoY, 2026Q2) can keep smokeable adjusted OCI growing as accelerating trade-down dilutes it through MIX. The 2026Q2 print re-cut this hinge: headline price realization fell 6.3% -> 4.5% NOT on Marlboro pricing weakness but on Basic's volume/share growth, so the variable is now PM USA's premium/discount RGM mix management against a ~5% industry volume decline, not raw price-vs-volume.
